clauses: This prominent economist and university teacher is widely recognized for their foundational contributions to economic theory.
Throughout their academic career, they were elected as a Fellow of the Econometric Society and awarded a Guggenheim Fellowship.
Ultimately, their work was recognized with the Prize in Economic Sciences in Memory of Alfred Nobel, and they also hold an honorary doctorate from the NOVA University Lisbon.
However, despite their extensive prestige in the field, they never won the John Bates Clark Medal, nor did they pursue their education at Harvard University or the University of Chicago.
